about.title: About the Guardians Rising set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Guardians Rising is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 5 May 2017. It has 169 cards: 145 in the main set and 24 secret rares. There are also 118 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 145 main set cards), the Master set (263 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 287 cards, adding the 24 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
